freeze.freeze_condition: Frozen only after the three DAY-16 files are committed; first data task records commit SHA and file SHA-256.
freeze.change_policy: Any change after the freeze commit = new protocol version (v2.0.x clarification, v2.1 otherwise) and new experiment IDs.

drafting_constraints.review_task: DAY-16R (no data, no prices, no code, no backtest)

universe.missing_data: symbol ineligible for that decision only; never imputed, replaced or removed for performance
universe.survivorship_statement: hindsight-selected universe; known limitation; B1 does not eliminate survivorship bias; no v2 result may be described as survivorship-safe

data.provider: Alpaca Market Data API v2 Historical Stock Bars
data.close_available_after: 16:00 ET (13:00 ET on early closes) of the session
data.open_role: fill price only for decisions made at or before the previous close

hard_fail: raw vs all session-date set mismatch
blocking_review: symbol missing > 2% of sessions in an evaluated segment

acquisitions.when: only after research gate recorded for all families and >=1 RESEARCH-PASSED
only after forward period ended (>=16:15 ET last session) and >=1 HOLDOUT-PASSED

data.snapshot_policy: write-once; content and file SHA-256; one stage snapshot per run; raw bars and events compared IDENTICAL/DISCREPANCY on stage overlaps (R∩H 2021-01-04..2022-12-30, H∩F 2025-01-02..2026-06-02); adjustment=all levels excluded from overlap comparison (rebasing), implied factors re-checked per stage

corporate_action_events.source: Alpaca corporate-actions endpoint (endpoint/version recorded at acquisition)
fields: cash_per_share d (per share held at previous close, pre-split basis)
corporate_action_events.other_types: BLOCKING data review before any run

data.session_indexing: all t-k indices are XNYS calendar indices; missing bar at a required index = missing (no nearest-row fallback)
data.event_available_from: start of ex-date session (before its open)

segments.rule: XNYS sessions from 2026-06-03 to freeze-commit date inclusive
252 XNYS sessions starting at first session strictly after freeze-commit date

timeline.embargo_rationale: segments simulated separately, start flat, liquidate at last close; no position or label crosses a boundary

execution.fill_price: raw open O(t+1) (series A); never series B or C

missing_bar_at_execution.buy: cancelled; target weight stays cash until next scheduled decision (A/B) or slot's next signal (C)
missing_bar_at_execution.sell: pending sell retried at each later open with a bar until filled or superseded by a newer decision for the symbol
missing_bar_at_execution.look_ahead: retry is pre-committed; reads no information after the decision close

execution.gaps: fill at open regardless of gap; no stops or limits
order_of_operations: sells at raw open, cash += proceeds*(1-s)
buys scaled by lambda = min(1, K/(B*(1+s))), cash -= lambda*B*(1+s)
execution.simultaneous_signals: A/B one target vector per execution; C independent disjoint slots; sells then buys, ascending ticker
execution.initial_portfolio: each strategy evaluates its own signal formula at the session immediately before the segment start (even off-schedule) and executes at the segment's first open
execution.segment_boundaries: decisions at the segment's last close discarded; pending orders at segment end discarded

costs.formula: cost = s * sum(|traded notional|), deducted at execution
costs.threshold_semantics: friction scenario, not a profitability threshold

portfolio.accounting: E(k) = cash + sum shares*mark at each close; raw price basis only; independent simulation per (strategy or benchmark, segment, cost)
portfolio.sizing: E_open = cash + sum shares*v (v = raw open, or last mark if no bar); target notional = w*E_open (A/B) or slot capital (C)
portfolio.segment_end: mark at last close; deduct s x sum(shares*mark); discard pending orders
portfolio.turnover_definition: TO = 0.5 * sum_i |executed trade notional_i| / E_open per execution; annual = sum(TO)/(sessions/252)

corporate_actions.split: shares *= q on ex-date (start of session)
corporate_actions.cash_dividend: cash += shares held at previous close * d on ex-date; not reinvested; pay-date lag ignored

portfolio.marking: raw close; if missing, last close / product of split ratios since that close

V2-MOM.name: Cross-sectional momentum 12-1
V2-MOM.signal_session: last XNYS session of each calendar month
V2-MOM.eligibility: TR(t-21) and TR(t-252) defined at those exact calendar indices
V2-MOM.exit: not selected at rebalance, or segment end
V2-MOM.existing_holdings: still selected -> resized to 0.20 of E_open; not selected -> sold in full; new -> bought to 0.20
V2-MOM.cash_between_rebalances: allowed: unselected weight, cancelled buys, lambda, dividends; not reinvested until next rebalance

V2-STR.name: Weekly short-term reversal, long-only
V2-STR.signal_session: last XNYS session of each ISO week
V2-STR.sigma: std(ddof=1) of the 60 daily returns R(k), k=t-59..t (daily volatility; includes R(t); rolling, recomputed each signal)
V2-STR.eligibility: 61 TR closes t-60..t defined and sigma > 0
V2-STR.exit: not selected at rebalance, or segment end
V2-STR.centring: cross-sectional mean of r5 over eligible symbols at the same t (not historical)
V2-STR.existing_holdings: still selected -> resized to 0.20 of E_open; not selected -> sold in full; new -> bought to 0.20

V2-LRV.name: Long-only relative value (distance method, lagging leg only)
V2-LRV.cycles: sequential non-overlapping; next formation close = p125; first cycle t_F = session before segment start; last cycle truncated
V2-LRV.distance: SSD_ij = sum_{k in F} (N_i(k)-N_j(k))^2, ticker_i < ticker_j
V2-LRV.pair_selection: ascending SSD, ties lexicographic; greedy disjoint; 5 pairs
V2-LRV.sigma: std(ddof=1) of D_ij(k)=N_i(k)-N_j(k) over F; frozen for the trading period
V2-LRV.spread: S_ij(t) = M_i(t) - M_j(t), ticker_i < ticker_j (GGR convention: sigma on formation-normalised D, spread rebased at t_F)
V2-LRV.entry: slot flat with no pending order and trigger holds -> buy lagging member with entire slot capital
exit: convergence: s0*S(t) <= 0 at close t in p0..p124 -> sell at open t+1
period end: position open after close p125 -> sell at open p126 (first session of next cycle)
V2-LRV.slot_capital: E_open(p0) after previous-cycle exits and costs / 5; evolves with own P&L, costs and dividends; no cross-slot lending
V2-LRV.missing_data: no signal if either member's TR undefined at close; existing position held and marked per portfolio.marking
V2-LRV.residual_market_exposure: single-stock long (beta ~1, not estimated) or cash; not market-neutral; exposure reported every session
V2-LRV.notation: trading period p0..p125; t_F = session before p0; formation F = t_F-251..t_F; F0 = t_F-251
V2-LRV.lagging_member: j if S>0, i if S<0
V2-LRV.entry_window: closes p0..p124; execute at next open
V2-LRV.same_close_exit_and_entry: no entry evaluated for a slot on a close where its exit fires
V2-LRV.holding_while_signal: further triggers for an occupied slot ignored; other slots independent
V2-LRV.simultaneous_triggers: independent disjoint slots; sells before buys

B1.definition: equal-weight buy-and-hold of the 25 universe symbols with a bar at the segment's first open, same engine and accounting as strategies, never rebalanced, splits adjust shares, dividends credited as cash and not reinvested, same lambda rule and costs on initial buy and final liquidation

B2.definition: SPY buy-and-hold, 100% target weight at segment first open, same engine, accounting and costs

metrics.undefined_policy: mathematically undefined metric reported as 'undefined' with reason; never imputed

gate.applies: per strategy, independently and identically to all three families; research, then unchanged on holdout and forward
A_methodological_hard_fail: data corruption / structural failure / unresolved BLOCKING data review / manifest mismatch
execution or accounting semantics violated (incl. any non-raw fill or mark)

B_economic.sufficiency: necessary minimum only; not evidence of an edge
B_economic.comparison: unrounded float64; equality passes; same engine/sessions/exclusions/cost for B1

gate.C_robustness: completeness only: every robustness item present (value or 'undefined (reason)') for 0/5/10 bps; no thresholds; never causes PASS/FAIL by value; never used to choose, modify or rank; missing item = FAIL

multiple_testing.new_experiment_trigger: any change to any frozen value
multiple_testing.diagnostic: HAC t-stat vs B1 with Holm across families; diagnostic only: cannot pass, fail or rescue a family, override the gate, or select among families
multiple_testing.failed_families: recorded as failed; never silently modified; any modified version is a new DERIVED experiment

graduation.advance: all families passing a stage advance together
graduation.holdout_run_after: research gate recorded for all three families
graduation.holdout_acquisition: Stage H only after research gate recorded for all three families and >=1 passed
graduation.no_rescue: research-failed families are never run on the holdout; no holdout result rescues them
graduation.post_freeze_data: no data dated after the freeze commit acquired or inspected before the forward period ends

B_signal.definition: TR(k0)=1; TR(k)=TR(p)*(C(k)*Q(p,k)+D(p,k))/C(p), p = previous session with a bar; Q = product of split ratios with ex-date in (p,k]; D = sum of dividends with ex-date e in (p,k] times product of split ratios in (e,k]; undefined where C(k) missing
B_signal.pit_property: depends only on raw closes and events with ex-date <= k

forbidden: any signal, fill, mark, weight or P&L input
C_audit.cross_check: every f change (> 1e-6 relative) must match an event and vice versa; split ratio within 0.1%; mismatch = BLOCKING data review
